_why: F-14 regression (round-2 send-back item 2). gitcmd.push_target_branch takes tokens[1] -- the FIRST refspec after the remote -- NOT tokens[-1], despite pr-state-guard.ps1's own comment claiming 'last'. Preserved as-coded for parity. 'a' and 'b' are given DIFFERENT PR states so a tokens[1]->tokens[-1] mutation changes the OUTCOME (exit code), not just which branch name is quoted in the message: branch 'a' has only a MERGED PR (must BLOCK), branch 'b' has an OPEN PR (would ALLOW). A mutant reading tokens[-1] resolves 'b', finds the OPEN PR, and ALLOWS -- silently flipping expect_exit from 2 to 0.
expect_stderr_contains: BLOCKED (PR state): branch 'a' has no OPEN pull request
